name: Vipul Shah
bio: I’m a Android/iOS developer, currently working for a Backbase as an Android & iOS Developer. I love public speaking and presenting talks. I regularly give talks at GDG events & Local meetups, and blog at Medium. Before joining Backbase I was working with awesome product teams @Microsoft. I have been developing Android & iOS applications since last 7 years and have worked for few notable clients like FirstData, BMW, Wallmart labs. During my tenure in Microsoft I was part core Outlook team and worked on couple of Office apps. I regularly speak at technical events like GDG & Developer meetups.
